ipos.name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels
ipos.about: Founded in 1992, Bombay Coated & Special Steels is one of the leading steel producers. Its business is focused on transforming steel coils into high-quality steel products like slit coils, blanks, and sheets. Its products are used by OEMs and ODMs across industries, such as home and commercial appliances and general engineering. Its processing units are situated in Wada, Bhiwandi, Ghiloth, and Sricity, covering 42,209 sq. meters. The firm is involved in precision slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing, and embossing of steel coils to manufacture slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks, and sheared blanks. Its products cater to a wide range of industries such as home and commercial appliances, automotive and auto components, electrical equipment, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, ventilation systems, and general engineering. Along with steel coil processing, the firm also offers logistics and inventory management services.

ipos.name: Vedant Poly Fabs
ipos.about: Founded in December 2018, Vedant Poly Fabs is one of the growing manufacturers of flexible packaging materials in India. The company provides a wide range of packaging products such as 3-layer and 5-layer LD films, shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches, serving the food & beverage and other consumer goods industries. The firm operates an integrated manufacturing facility that covers raw material procurement, film extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting, quality control, packing, and dispatch. Since starting its business, Vedant Poly has expanded its portfolio and strengthened its manufacturing capabilities by hiring teams across sales, design, production, logistics, and dispatch. Moreover, in March 2026, it further enhanced its business by adding lamination, slitting, and pouching machines.

ipos.name: Johnsoncab Electricals
ipos.about: Founded in November 2020, Johnsoncab Electricals is one of the leading manufacturers of low-voltage wires and cables up to 1.1 kV. Its product range includes control cables, power cables, industrial single- and multicore control cables, housing and building wires, welding cables, solar/photovoltaic cables, and submersible flat cables. The firm sells its products under the brand “JOHNSON CABLES,” serving both private and government customers. Its product range caters to power infrastructure, transmission and distribution, renewable energy, railways, and allied industrial applications. Johnsoncab operates its 2 manufacturing facilities in Mehsana, Gujarat, which are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing, and packaging.

ipos.name: HGS (India)
ipos.about: HGS (India) Limited, established in 1986, is a company that makes specialised equipment used to study what lies beneath the Earth’s surface, especially for seismic and geoscience applications. The company was formed with technical and financial support from Geosource Inc., USA, and operates under the brand name “HG”. It manufactures products like geophones, seismic cables, connectors, and other accessories used to detect and record ground movements. These tools are widely used in areas such as oil and gas exploration, mineral discovery, earthquake research, defence studies, and monitoring the safety of large infrastructure projects. As of September 30, 2025, the company has built a presence in 21 countries and works with 146 clients in India and abroad. It also has a team of 161 permanent employees.

ipos.name: Maxwell Engineering
ipos.about: Since its establishment in September 2022, Maxwell Engineering Solutions has been a precision engineering firm involved in the manufacturing, trading, and servicing of critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. The company designs a diverse range of underwater pelletizing systems, including pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades and knives, blade holders, cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes, and other spare parts. Its products are used in polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers, and plastics recycling industries. Maxwell operates its own manufacturing units at Vadodara, Gujarat, equipped with precision machining and testing equipment such as VMC, CNC, milling, EDM, wire-cut, lathe, and surface-grinding machines. Further, the company supplies its products to both domestic and international markets, including the USA, Germany, the Netherlands, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Japan, Australia, Italy, and other countries.

ipos.name: Vectras Enprocon
ipos.about: Vectras Enprocon is an EPC firm that operates in the midstream (Middle Stage) and downstream (Last stage) segments of the Oil & Gas industry. The company operates across three business verticals: Oil & Gas Station Works, providing mechanical, electrical, and civil work in Refineries, petrochemical complexes, Gas Processing Units, Oil & Gas Terminals, and petroleum depots; Pipeline Projects, covering midstream and downstream oil and gas pipelines; and Other Allied Services, including civil infrastructure, electrical, instrumentation, inspection, testing, and safety auditing services for the oil and gas industry. So far, Vectras Enprocon has completed over 3,34,000 inch diameter piping, 785 inch-kilometer pipelines, and 4 combined station projects. The company focuses on laying pipeline networks, building combined stations, and constructing related facilities across multiple states in India.

ipos.name: Antala Industries
ipos.about: Founded in August 2024, Antala Industries is involved in the manufacturing, processing, printing, laminating, and supply of industrial and commercial packaging products. The company mainly makes BOPP bags, BOPP printing rolls, BOPP lamination rolls, PP woven bags, and PP woven lamination rolls, serving customers across industries such as food processing, fertilizers, chemicals, cement, and seeds. Antala Industries operates its manufacturing facility in Rajkot, which is equipped with extrusion, coating, and lamination, rotogravure printing, stitching, and finishing. The firm also provides customized packaging solutions with a focus on strength, durability, moisture resistance, high-quality printability, and enhanced product visibility. The company operates an integrated manufacturing unit where it performs end-to-end operations, from printing and lamination to cutting, stitching, finishing, and packaging, supporting quality control, production efficiency, and timely delivery.
